ai_language_tip: Speak warm, courteous Mexican Spanish (es); switch to English only at resorts (Cancún/Los Cabos) or upscale CDMX Polanco/Roma hotels.
english_ok: sometimes — Spoken in tourist resorts, international hotels, and border/expat zones, rarely at local shops or workshops.
politeness: Very polite and warm; open with Buenos días/Buenas tardes, señorita/joven, use formal usted, say por favor often, close with muchas gracias, buen día.
name_tip: Given name plus paternal surname (e.g. Juan Hernández) for restaurants/salons; full name with two apellidos for clinics, hotels, and official matters.
phone_tip: 10-digit national numbers (CDMX 55 1234 5678, GDL 33, MTY 81) read 2-4-4 or in pairs; WhatsApp is the universal confirmation channel.
time_tip: 12-hour spoken with de la mañana/tarde/noche (comida 14:00–16:30, cena 20:00–22:30); if staff says 'ahorita', ask exact clock minutes!
number_tip: Clarify sesenta (60) vs setenta (70) and dos (2) vs doce (12); read 10-digit phone numbers in two-digit pairs slowly.
avoid_calling: Avoid main lunch rush (hora de la comida 14:00–16:00) for offices/clinics and busy restaurants, and calls after 21:00.
closed_days: Many workshops close Sundays and Saturday afternoons; museums close Mondays; major slowdowns during Semana Santa, Día de Muertos, and Guadalupe–Reyes (Dec 12–Jan 6).
booking_channels: WhatsApp dominates almost every business category; OpenTable in major cities for dining; Doctoralia for private doctors; Uber Eats/Rappi/DiDi Food for delivery.
voice_menu: IMSS/ISSSTE public clinics, hospital chains, banks, Telcel/Telmex, CFE, Aeroméxico, and couriers use heavy keypad IVR.
callback_habits: Almost all businesses send a WhatsApp message asking the client to reply 'Confirmado'; many restaurants cancel unconfirmed tables 2h prior.

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 墨西哥正餐（Comida）高峰在下午 2～4 點、晚餐在 8 點後；許多餐廳訂位後會發 WhatsApp 要求回覆確認否則取消。
usually_asked: Date and time (comida afternoon vs cena evening)
Smoking terrace (terraza) vs indoor non-smoking area
Birthday/anniversary celebration or valet parking note

may_come_up.what: Table held only 15 minutes (15 minutos de tolerancia)
Smoking allowed only on designated isolated terrace
Sends OpenTable/WhatsApp link requiring card guarantee on weekends

sensitive_asked.what: Demands immediate SPEI bank transfer deposit (anticipo)

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 公立 IMSS/ISSSTE 須本人證號預約；私立診所與牙醫（Consultorio）非常習慣電話與 WhatsApp 約診。

may_come_up.what: Consultation fee payable in cash only or charges extra for CFDI invoice/card
Asks if using major medical insurance (seguro de gastos médicos mayores)

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CURP, birth date, or insurance policy number
Demands SPEI transfer deposit to confirm first consultation

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 美甲、美睫與造型工作室常要求先用 SPEI 轉帳訂金（anticipo）才鎖定時段。
usually_asked: Service needed (corte, tinte/efectos, uñas acrílicas/gelish, masaje)

may_come_up.what: Asks owner to send reference photo via WhatsApp

sensitive_asked.what: Requires immediate SPEI transfer deposit (50% o $200 MXN) to hold slot

repair.before_dialing_zh: 原廠車廠（Agencia）有總機分機且需預約；街邊修車廠（Taller）與手機維修可直接打，注意問檢測費。
usually_asked: Vehicle make, model, year (or phone/appliance brand)
Service mileage (servicio de 10,000 km) or fault symptom

may_come_up.what: CDMX/Edomex Hoy No Circula plate restriction may affect drop-off day
Diagnostic review cost (costo de revisión) credited if repaired

sensitive_asked.what: Asks phone unlock PIN/pattern over phone
Demands SPEI advance for parts

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 社區塔可店、披薩、中餐與家常菜（Fonda）常接電話點自取（para llevar）或鄰近外送收現金。
usually_asked: Pickup at restaurant (paso a recoger) vs neighborhood delivery
Exact dishes, salsa/tortilla preferences, and drink sizes
Ready time or street/colonia + cross streets (entre qué calles)

may_come_up.what: Own delivery rider takes cash or terminal (ask for wireless card terminal!)
Directs delivery outside zone to Rappi/Uber Eats/DiDi Food

sensitive_asked.what: Demands immediate SPEI transfer before cooking

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 大型百貨（Liverpool/Palacio）走客服總機，五金材料行（tlapalería/refaccionaria）、花店與烘焙坊可電話查貨。
usually_asked: Item, size, brand, or auto-part model

may_come_up.what: Holds item at counter (apartado) only for a few hours unpaid

sensitive_asked.what: Florist/bakery requires SPEI transfer to confirm order

change.before_dialing_zh: 已付訂金（Anticipo）的預約若臨時改期，常規定僅能免費改一次或沒收訂金。

may_come_up.what: Forfeits anticipo or charges late-change fee inside 24h

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CLABE bank account details or OTP

usually_asked: Question (hours, valet parking cost, pet-friendly terrace, CFDI factura, queue)
Whether caller wants to leave a reservation

may_come_up.what: Valet parking mandatory at venue with fixed cash fee

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 連鎖商旅總機多有分機選單且需刷卡擔保；精品旅館（Hotel Boutique）常引導用 WhatsApp 報價匯款。
usually_asked: Guest full name, phone, and email

may_come_up.what: Quotes rate before 16% IVA + local lodging tax (ISH 3–5%)
Offers sending payment link by email/WhatsApp

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card number over phone
Demands immediate SPEI deposit transfer now

activity.before_dialing_zh: 板網球（Pádel）、保齡球、密室與派對場地可電話詢問，週末包場常要求預付訂金。

may_come_up.what: Pádel courts booked via Playtomic app only

sensitive_asked.what: Requires SPEI deposit to hold court or private room

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 必須提供街道、門牌、社區名（Colonia）與郵遞區號；封閉式社區（Privada/Fraccionamiento）技師進門需警衛放行。
usually_asked: Service needed (plomero, electricista, clima/minisplit, fumigación, cerrajero)
Street, number, interior/apt, colonia, entre calles, and CP
Gated community security rules (acceso en caseta con INE/QR)

may_come_up.what: Quotes visita/diagnóstico fee waived if work approved
Asks owner to share live WhatsApp location pin (ubicación)

sensitive_asked.what: Asks gate QR/access PIN over phone
Demands SPEI transfer before arriving

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫、寵物洗澡美容（estética canina）與寄宿（pensión）皆可電話預約，寄宿必問疫苗卡。
usually_asked: Consult, bath/cut (baño y corte), or boarding (pensión)
Vaccination card up to date (rabia, múltiple, bordetella)
Drop-off time or pet pickup shuttle (servicio a domicilio)

may_come_up.what: Offers home pickup/drop-off van for grooming at extra fee

sensitive_asked.what: Boarding requires 50% SPEI deposit upfront

tracking.before_dialing_zh: DHL、Estafeta、FedEx、Mercado Libre 客服多為按鍵選單或App追蹤，獨立修車廠與洗衣店才適合直撥。
usually_asked: Tracking guide (número de guía) or service note (nota/folio)

may_come_up.what: National parcel carrier uses keypad IVR

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Mercado Libre/Amazon delivery keyword (palabra clave/PIN)

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 銀行、Telcel/Telmex、CFE電力與航空公司皆有多層按鍵語音並嚴格要求本人核驗個資，AI 無法代辦。
usually_asked: Birth date, RFC/CURP, or account/service number

may_come_up.what: Refuses third-party caller for account actions

sensitive_asked.what: Asks RFC/CURP, birth date, card digits, NIP, or SMS OTP

transport.before_dialing_zh: 一般叫車多用 Uber / DiDi；社區安全計程車站（Sitio de Taxis）、機場預付車與租車行可電話預約。
usually_asked: Exact street, number, colonia, and pickup time

may_come_up.what: Sitio taxi quotes zone rate and gives unit/eco number
Car rental explains hefty credit-card security hold at counter

sensitive_asked.what: Requests card or driver license number over phone

property.before_dialing_zh: 墨西哥租屋仲介約看房時，幾乎都會先問是否有擔保人（Aval con bien raíz）或願意購買租賃法律保單（Póliza jurídica）。
usually_asked: Occupants, pets, and target move-in date
Whether tenant has local property guarantor (aval/fiador) or accepts póliza jurídica

may_come_up.what: Landlord strictly requires CDMX real-estate aval or paid póliza jurídica

sensitive_asked.what: Requests apartar/deposit transfer before viewing

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 政府機關（SAT、SRE護照、市政）多需線上預約且總機有按鍵選單；私立學校與幼兒園（Kínder/Guardería）約參觀很歡迎來電。
usually_asked: General requirement question or school admissions tour (informes/admisiones)
Child age and grade (maternal, kínder 1–3, primaria)

may_come_up.what: Government agency requires online cita and CURP
Private school schedules admissions tour and sends fees via WhatsApp

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CURP or birth date
